suite.description: The Debian suite codename or symbolic name (e.g., trixie, bookworm, sid).

target.description: The output target path (directory, tarball, image) or '-' for stdout.

mirrors.description: List of mirror URIs or apt source lines. If empty, uses default Debian mirror.

variant.description: The package set variant to install (e.g., debootstrap, essential, buildd, custom).

mode.description: The execution mode (e.g., auto, sudo, unshare, chrootless).

format.description: The output format (e.g., auto, directory, tar, squashfs, ext4).

aptopt.description: List of apt configuration options to append to 99mmdebstrap.conf in the chroot.

dpkgopt.description: List of dpkg configuration options to append to 99mmdebstrap.cfg in the chroot.

include.description: List of additional packages or apt patterns to install.

components.description: List of repository components (e.g., main, contrib, non-free) to enable.

architectures.description: List of architectures to enable (first is native).

keyring.description: Path to a keyring file or directory for apt key verification.

hooks.description: Hook commands for different stages of the chroot creation.

skip.description: List of stages or checks to skip (e.g., check/empty, cleanup/apt/lists).

logfile.description: Path to a log file. Empty string means output to stderr.
